items.question: A word that joins two clauses is a?
Which sentence is in the active voice?
options: The boy was bitten by the dog

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (96 marks)
items: 1. Read the passage and answer the comprehension questions. (10 marks)
2. Rewrite the following sentences correcting the errors: 'He don't like rice.' 'The committee have made its decision.' (4 marks)
3. Write the comparative and superlative of: many, ill, far. (3 marks)
4. Explain the difference between a metaphor and a simile, giving an example of each. (4 marks)
5. Write an essay of about 350 words on 'The value of hard work'. (25 marks)
